profile.headline: Web Developer at Institute of Transportation Studies at the University of California, Davis

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Currently, I design, develop, and maintain sites for ITS and it's affiliated sites using HTML/CSS and Wordpress. I also communicate directly with our clients to ensure they are satisfied with the design and development choices I've made.

company.name: Institute of Transportation Studies at the University of California, Davis

positions.title: Logistics Lead
positions.description: Served as the Logistics Lead for the all-women and non-binary hackathon, Spectra. My responsibilities included managing the food and apparel budgeting. Additionally, I completed tasks across all teams to optimize and expedite workflow.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: I tutor in a variety of undergraduate, computer science courses at UC Davis through the Computer Science Department's tutoring committee as well as host exam review sessions. My focus is primarily in intro courses where I try to make esoteric concepts more accessible as well as helping beginners develop confidence in coding.

positions.title: Summer Camp Counselor
positions.description: In this position, I acted as both teacher and mentor to a group of young girls I was assigned to. As part of my job, I picked up Stencyl, a block-based, game, programming software. From there, I taught the girls the fundamentals of programming logic and worked with them day by day to help them reach their goals of creating a game prototype.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description: My primary position in the company was graphic designer for t-shirts. I collaborated with other graphic designers in the company and directly with clients to ensure quality designs. Since the company was small, I was also tasked with promoting the brand throughout the community to receive orders as well as managing financial aspects of orders I personally worked on.

positions.title: Freelance Artist
positions.description: I co-developed a brand and worked at several animation conventions. Here, I learned how to manage company expenses, promote the brand via social media, research trending subject designs,  and engage directly with customers while delivering quality art under rigid deadlines.
